subject: Spot-check: training attestations + exit log for contractor cohort 47
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmebank.com>
To: logan_wright@redwoodinference.com
Cc: audits@veritas-security.com
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2/CAIQ spot-check: onboarding/offboarding proofs request

Hi Logan,

Aurora's SOC 2 team is doing a short spot-check on onboarding and offboarding controls tied to the SIG/CAIQ evidence bundle. Can you provide the following for contractor cohort 47 (eng + data ops contractors who started in Q4 2027):

- Training completion roster (CSV) with columns: name, redacted_employee_id, role, module_completed, completion_date, trainer_id.
- A redacted background-check summary (no PII like SSN/DOB; indicate scope and clearance outcome).
- Confirmation of exit steps for any contractors who left before 90 days (deprovisioning checklist, badge termination) and dates performed.

Please include guidance on how PII was redacted and which vendor ran background checks. We only need a handful of representative records (not full population) — a sample of 20 from cohort 47 is fine.

Target turnaround: within one week if possible. If you need a specific CSV template, we can share one.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Nguyen
Senior Information Assurance Manager, Aurora Financial

From: logan_wright@redwoodinference.com
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmebank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/CAIQ spot-check: onboarding/offboarding proofs request

Claire — thanks for the note. We can provide the sample set and supporting notes. Quick clarifications so we deliver exactly what's needed:

1) For the CSV, do you want trainer_id mapped to internal staff only, or can that point to our external training vendor IDs?
2) For background checks: you asked for "summary" — would a redacted PDF showing scope (criminal, identity verification), vendor (ClearCheckr) and outcome (clear / investigations) be acceptable? We will remove DOB/SSNs and hash badge IDs.
3) Offboarding confirmation: we have an automated deprovision log in the console and a separate HR checklist. Do you want both, or the HR checklist only?

Our proposed timeline: sample CSV + redacted background summary + consolidated offboard checklist by EOD next Friday (2028-04-09). If you need it sooner we can prioritize a smaller sample.

Cc'ing Kimberly and Karthik to coordinate attachments and redaction.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: logan_wright@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 04 Apr 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/CAIQ spot-check: onboarding/offboarding proofs request

Team — will take point on data pull and redaction. Plan:

- Training roster: export from LMS filtered to cohort 47; will produce training_roster_Q1_2028.csv (we will include only requested columns and strip email addresses). Trainer IDs will be internal staff ids; external vendor sessions will be marked with "vendor:SkillForge" in the trainer_id field.
- Background checks: order a representative bundle (20 records) from ClearCheckr and produce redacted_background_summary_cohort47.pdf. Redaction policy: remove DOB and SSN, truncate address to city/state, replace badge_id with SHA256 hash (we'll include the salt description in the notes).
- Offboard checklist: offboard_checklist_batch47.xlsx will contain the HR checklist plus the automated deprovision timestamps exported from the console for the affected users.

Attachments will be staged to a secure Drive folder and a DocuSign-style attestation will be appended for the sample owner to sign. I expect the prepared files by EOD 2028-04-09.

Note: ClearCheckr will be CC'd for data pull logistics.

— Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security & People Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmebank.com>
To: logan_wright@redwoodinference.com
Cc: audits@veritas-security.com
Date: Thu, 05 Apr 2028 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/CAIQ spot-check: onboarding/offboarding proofs request

Thanks Logan / Kimberly — that scope looks good. A couple small items before you finalize:

- For the sample CSV, please include a column "attestation_status" indicating whether the user completed the training voluntarily or as a condition of employment/engagement.
- For the redaction notes, include the exact hash algorithm and whether a salt was used (we only need high-level detail; please don't include the salt value).
- For offboarding timestamps, please include the admin username that performed the deprovisioning (redact personal emails if necessary).

We'll accept a secure Drive share or an encrypted ZIP delivered via our vendor audit mailbox. If possible, attach a short cover note describing the selection method used for the sample (random stratified by role and start_date).

One more ask: as part of CAIQ evidence mapping, please reference the SIG question IDs you're addressing (if you can map the roster/controls to SIG IDs that will expedite our review).

Regards,
Claire

From: logan_wright@redwoodinference.com
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmebank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, platform@clearcheckr.com
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/CAIQ spot-check: onboarding/offboarding proofs request — delivery

Claire — attached is the sample set and our notes. Summary of deliverables in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_drive_link

- training_roster_Q1_2028.csv (20 sample rows, columns per your request; includes attestation_status).
- redacted_background_summary_cohort47.pdf (vendor: ClearCheckr; scope: identity + criminal; outcomes: clear / flags noted; redaction: DOB/SSN removed, addresses truncated, badge_id hashed with SHA256 — salt used, not included).
- offboard_checklist_batch47.xlsx (HR checklist and automated deprovision timestamps with admin usernames).
- cover_note_sample_selection.txt (describes random stratified sampling by role and start_date).
- mapping_SIG_ids.txt (maps exported items to SIG/CAIQ question IDs).

We also attached a short attestation from HR confirming the sample extraction method and that PII was redacted per policy. If you need the raw console logs, we can provide them via an encrypted channel on request.

Next steps: let us know if the sample meets your needs or if you want a second sample from a different stratification (e.g., contractor vs. vendor-engaged).

— Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
